## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Change type

- [ ] Scientific architecture / methodology
- [ ] Evidence / literature metadata
- [ ] Data ingestion / provenance
- [ ] Econometrics / statistics
- [ ] Agent / LLM workflow
- [ ] Evaluation / red team / replication
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI / tests / maintenance

## Scientific integrity checklist

- [ ] I preserved the exactly-two-core architecture.
- [ ] I did not silently redefine a construct, estimand, causal label, welfare function, or discovery threshold.
- [ ] I did not fabricate citations, data, coefficients, benchmarks, or empirical findings.
- [ ] Any new evidence source has provenance and appropriate access/licensing.
- [ ] Any empirical claim is correctly classified as descriptive, associational, predictive, causal, structural/equilibrium, or replicated.
- [ ] The change does not optimize solely for statistical significance.
- [ ] Relevant robustness, falsification, chronology/leakage, OOS, or replication checks are documented.
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, personal data, confidential manuscripts, or restricted datasets are included.

## Validation

List tests run, data checks, benchmark comparisons, or manual validation performed.

## Evidence Passport impact

Explain whether this PR changes provenance, evidence classification, scientific gates, model/tool versions, or Human Gate behavior.

## IP / license check

- [ ] The contribution is compatible with the repository license and contribution terms.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute all included code, text, metadata, and data artifacts.

## Human review

No pull request, automated test, or model output constitutes scientific approval. Final scientific interpretation remains subject to human review.
